advisory_note: Learning artifact for issue-to-solution traceability. Runtime behavior still requires board validation.

issues.title: TX SoundWire slave remains UNATTACHED at codec probe time
symptom_signature: wcd9378-codec: TX SoundWire slave enumeration timed out
sdw:3:0:0217:0110:00:3 status=UNATTACHED while RX is Attached
issues.root_cause_hypothesis: TX attach/initialization race with SoundWire master runtime power/clock state during probe window.

key_points: [17.121276] TX SoundWire slave enumeration timed out

applied_solutions.solution: Add enumeration_complete wait and move codec pm_runtime_resume_and_get before waits
applied_solutions.effect: Failure moved from initialization timeout to enumeration timeout; issue persists

applied_solutions.solution: Hold tx_sdw_dev->bus->dev runtime PM during waits and return -EPROBE_DEFER when TX is still UNATTACHED
applied_solutions.effect: Avoids hard terminal -110 path when TX attach is late; enables retry semantics

next_actions: Board re-test and confirm whether deferred retry allows successful card instantiation
If still UNATTACHED, collect TX clock/runtime PM evidence during probe window
Validate TX master DTS port configuration against controller expectations

issues.title: SoundWire identity placeholders were unresolved
issues.root_cause_hypothesis: Identity constants were intentionally fail-closed pending hardware evidence.

applied_solutions.solution: Replace candidate macros with WCD9378_SDW_PART_ID and WCD9378_SDW_COMPATIBLE and update references
applied_solutions.effect: Identity constants now hardware-confirmed and deterministic

next_actions: Keep identity constants locked unless new hardware evidence contradicts current tuple

issues.title: TX controller warning: dout-ports mismatch with controller

key_points: warning appears before codec bind logs

applied_solutions.effect: Iteration capture now append-only, validated, and repeatable

next_actions: Use append tool for every future WCD9378 iteration
